extracted.intended_audience: medical students, practitioners, laboratory workers, medical librarians, and instructors selecting medical textbooks
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and desiderata for selecting, evaluating, or producing medical and laboratory textbooks and manuals (coverage, illustrations, practical utility, currency, authorship, format, etc.). Geared toward buyers, teachers, and students in medical fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Up-to-dateness / Revised editions
rubrics_metrics.description: New or revised editions that correct obsolete material and add new advances are valued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Praises such as 'The New (5th) Edition', 'Reprinted in three months', 'this edition represents all the advances recently made', 'every page has been gone over most carefully, correcting, omitting the obsolete, and adding the new.' Emphasizes including the latest technic and bringing editions 'right down to the minute.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical / clinical applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Emphasis on material that is directly helpful in practical branches of medicine and clinical work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phrases: 'Main emphasis has been laid upon those facts and views which will be directly helpful in the practical branches of medicine.'; 'practical application of pathologic facts to clinical medicine'; 'written for the physician... and for the medical student.' Books are framed from the clinician's point of view where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage and completeness of subject
rubrics_metrics.description: Thorough, comprehensive treatment of the field—covering the full scope expected of the subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'embraces the entire field of bacteriology,' 'contains a great mass of well-classified facts,' 'most complete students' text-book on Histology in existence,' 'covers the ground more completely than any other American book.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority and authorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Authorship by established experts and professors lends credibility and is cited as a criterion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated endorsements list authors' positions: 'Professor of Pathology, Johns Hopkins,' 'Director of the Pathologic Laboratory, Massachusetts General Hospital,' etc., and reviewers note the author's qualifications when recommending the book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality, number, and usefulness of illustrations
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations (including color plates) should be numerous, accurate, beautiful, and practically useful for understanding and diagnosis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Praises such as 'illustrations are most beautiful,' '400 text-cuts, many in colors,' 'superb illustrations,' 'the illustrations are the best the world affords,' 'colored lithographic plates produced with over thirty colors.' Guidance emphasizes fidelity (true colors from stained sections) and practical arrangement with accompanying descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity of presentation and organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Material should be arranged and written for easy access, comprehension, and logical progression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phrases: 'presented in a logical way,' 'arranged in such a manner as to be easy of access and comprehension,' 'subheadings that clearly indicate the subject-matter to be found on each page.' Also praise for 'clearness and precision of style.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical laboratory technic and methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuals should give clear, tested methods and technic for laboratory work, autopsies, and clinical diagnosis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'A Practical Manual for Workers in Pathologic Histology, including Directions for the Performance of Autopsies and for Clinical Diagnosis by Laboratory Methods,' 'gives clearly the technic for the bacteriologic examination of water, sewage, air, soil, milk and its products, meats, etc.' Emphasis on methods 'attested by his own large experience.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Thoroughness, accuracy, and attention to detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Books should show thorough revision, accuracy of content, and careful attention to details of methods or facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phrases: 'thoroughness, his accuracy, his attention to detail make his work an important one,' 'has subjected his book to a most vigorous revision,' 'entirely rewritten' where needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability for target reader (student vs practitioner vs researcher)
rubrics_metrics.description: The work should be appropriate in depth and emphasis for the intended audience (students, practitioners, laboratory workers, researchers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements specifying intended readership: 'for the physician, for those engaged in research in pathology and physiologic chemistry, and for the medical student,' 'for the student and practitioner,' 'designed for practical instruction in the field and laboratory.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Conciseness and definition clarity (dictionaries/glossaries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference works should define terms concisely and include pronunciation, etymology, tables, and separate paragraphs per word for quick lookup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From the dictionary: 'It gives the capitalization and pronunciation of all words... the derivation or etymology... Every word has a separate paragraph, thus making it easy to find a word quickly... Every word is given its definition--a definition that defines in the fewest possible words.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of useful supplementary material (tables, indices, appendices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Helpful supporting material such as tables of arteries/muscles/nerves, thumb indices, colored plates, and appendices increase utility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'over 100 new and elaborate tables,' 'tables of arteries, muscles, nerves, veins, etc. are of the greatest help,' 'with thumb index,' 'Appendix on Scientific Aids to Surgical Diagnosis.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Didactic value and usefulness as teaching aid
rubrics_metrics.description: Works should serve as effective teaching resources—laboratory guides, manuals with questions, blank pages for notes, and concise compendia.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'prepared especially for Students of Medicine, and arranged with questions following each chapter,' 'blank pages are inserted for notes,' 'a laboratory course... for use of medical, agricultural, and industrial students.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance of theory and experimental/technical detail
rubrics_metrics.description: A good text gives both theoretical background and sufficient experimental/technical detail where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phrases: 'At the same time... sufficient consideration has been given to the experimental side of the science.'; 'presents his subject biologically, first by ascertaining the cellular elements... then he traces the development of the lesions.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Readability and quality of diction
rubrics_metrics.description: Tone and style—fine diction and clear presentation—are noted as virtues that make a book more pleasant and effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'It is remarkable for the fineness of its diction and for its clear presentation of the subject, relieved... by a quaintly humorous turn of phrase.'; 'discussed his subject with a clearness and precision of style.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustrations faithful to real specimens (accuracy of color & preparation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Plates and figures should reproduce the exact colors/effects of stains and be based on fresh, normal specimens where relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quotes: 'represent in the exact colors the effect of the stains, which is of such great importance for the differentiation of tissue.'; 'most of the illustrations were made from sections prepared from human tissues, and always from fresh and in every respect normal specimens.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Conciseness vs breadth tailored to purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Some works are praised for being concise yet comprehensive (ideal for quick surveys), others for exhaustive detail; appropriateness depends on intended use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'a general, all-round, yet concise survey,' 'a concise and systematic introduction to the study of micro-organisms,' versus 'an extensive, two-volume text of reference.' Choose format depending on need (overview vs reference).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diagnostic and therapeutic relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of diagnostic and therapeutic matter that can be interwoven with illustrative material is valued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: 'Considerable matter of a diagnostic and therapeutic nature has been interwoven.'; 'presentation includes laboratory diagnosis and serum treatment of specific diseases.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Value as standard/reference in the field
rubrics_metrics.description: Books that have become standard references or are 'indispensable' are highlighted as benchmarks of quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phrases: 'recognized as the standard guide,' 'has become well-nigh indispensable to the laboratory worker,' 'this edition has been in great part rewritten and very much enlarged... rendered the work the most complete students' text-book.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical arrangement for study and quick consultation
rubrics_metrics.description: Features that facilitate quick reference and study (clear subheadings, systematic part-division, practical arrangement) are important.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'treated systematically and quite fully under subheadings that clearly indicate the subject-matter to be found on each page,' 'Part I--Field and Laboratory Guide; Part II--Principles,' 'arranged with questions following each chapter.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Explicit statement of scope / intended applications
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear statement of what the book covers (e.g., non-pathogenic as well as pathogenic bacteria, or economic application) aids selection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'embraces the entire field of bacteriology, the non-pathogenic as well as the pathogenic bacteria being considered,' 'This work is both a general and medical biology... the economic phase is emphasized.'
